name: Fair Shuffle
text: Whenever you receive a card from another player, gain +10 contract value.

signature.trigger: you receive a card from another player

archetypes: Swap Meet; splash Kingmaker, Nil Guard
decision: Whether to take every optional swap and ask for passes, since each card that arrives pays.
opponent: Visible on trigger; opponents learn you have reached your bid and are shedding winners, and can answer by forcing tricks on you before you trade them away.
rationale: Every swap and every pass to you counts, so the whole Swap Meet toolkit feeds it: Open Hand, Traders' Handshake, Barter Bridge, Mystery Parcel, and a partner's passes. A Swap Meet seat receives two to four cards a round, about +20 to +40, about +20 EV.
deviation: Redesigned from paying for passes made after taking your bid, which had too few enablers.
